verdict.rationale: NotebookLM lets users pick output formats and prompt customization (e.g. 'Custom' response style, choosing Deep Dive vs other formats), but there is no evidence of controls to steer the depth, effort, or scope of an actual research/search process before or during execution — sources must be manually supplied and community feedback notes it cannot autonomously search for or scope additional documents (notebooklm-comm-4).
